Name: Stereo Information
Description: The STREO extension provides links between several images that form a stereo set to allow exploitation of elevation information. Use of STREO is optional, and there can be up to 3 STREO extensions per image.

ST_ID.Name: Stereo Mate
ST_ID.Description: This field contains the image ID of the stereo mate. This field contains the values of the first 60 characters of the ITITLE/IID2 field in the image subheader of the stereo mate image. NOTE: for more than one instance of a mate, see paragraph 3.15.2.

N_MATES.Name: Number of Stereo Mates
N_MATES.Description: This field contains the number of stereo mates. If there are no stereo mates, there will be no STREO extensions in the file. If there is a STREO extension, then there will be at least 1 stereo mate.

MATE_INSTANCE.Name: Mate Instance
MATE_INSTANCE.Description: This field identifies which stereo mate is described in this extension. For example, this field would contain a 2 for the second stereo mate.

B_CONV.Name: Beginning Convergence Angle
B_CONV.Description: This field contains the beginning convergence angle, which is defined at the first lines of the left and right images, unless those images are rotated more than 90 degrees to each other. If the images are rotated more than 90 degrees to each other, the last line of the right image shall be used. Accuracy of elevation measurements is reduced with large convergence angles.

E_CONV.Name: Ending Convergence Angle
E_CONV.Description: This field contains the ending convergence angle, which is defined at the last lines of the left and right images, unless those images are rotated more than 90 degrees to each other. If the images are rotated more than 90 degrees to each other, the first line of the right image shall be used. Accuracy of elevation measurements is reduced with large convergence angles.

B_ASYM.Name: Beginning Asymmetry Angle
B_ASYM.Description: This field contains the beginning asymmetry angle, which is defined at the first lines of the left and right images, unless those images are rotated more than 90 degrees to each other. If the images are rotated more than 90 degrees to each other, the last line of the right image shall be used.

E_ASYM.Name: Ending Asymmetry Angle
E_ASYM.Description: This field contains the ending asymmetry angle, which is defined at the last lines of the left and right images, unless those images are rotated more than 90 degrees to each other. If the images are rotated more than 90 degrees to each other, the first line of the right image shall be used.
